title: Search GitHub for Godot export template issue reports
key_points: The provided URL searches the GodotEngine/Godot repository on GitHub for issues related to export templates.
The search query specifically targets Linux, export, and template-related issues.
The search returns a total of 1085 matching issues, suggesting a significant number of users have encountered export template problems.
limitations: The results are limited to issues reported on GitHub and may not capture all user experiences or feedback.
asserts: There is a substantial number of reported issues related to Godot's export templates, particularly for the Linux platform.
